data.name: WindowTitle
data.value: Jarvis problem

data.name: WhatToDo
data.value: What to do:

data.name: OpenSetting
data.value: Open the “{0}” page

data.name: Detail
data.value: Technical detail: {0}

data.name: NoFault
data.value: No problem right now: Jarvis works normally.

data.name: Resolved
data.value: The problem is solved: Jarvis works normally again.

data.name: Microphone_Title
data.value: No microphone

data.name: Microphone_Explanation
data.value: No microphone can be used: it is unplugged, disabled in Windows, or another application holds it. Jarvis cannot hear you; the wake word, the hotkey and a click on the orb do not start listening.

data.name: Microphone_Action
data.value: Plug in a microphone or pick another one on the Audio page. The problem goes away as soon as a microphone answers. You can still write to Jarvis in the conversation window.

data.name: ModelUnreachable_Title
data.value: Language model unreachable

data.name: ModelUnreachable_Explanation
data.value: The language model server does not answer, or refuses the request. Jarvis hears your request but cannot answer it.

data.name: ModelUnreachable_Action
data.value: Check that the server is started (Ollama, llama-server…) and that the address and port on the Language models page are right, then run “Test the connection”. The problem goes away as soon as the model answers.

data.name: LanguageModelMissing_Title
data.value: Language model missing

data.name: LanguageModelMissing_Explanation
data.value: The server answers, but it does not have the chosen model.

data.name: LanguageModelMissing_Action
data.value: Download the model on the server (for instance “ollama pull qwen3:14b”), or pick on the Language models page a model the server offers.

data.name: VoiceModelMissing_Title
data.value: Voice missing

data.name: VoiceModelMissing_Explanation
data.value: The file of the chosen voice is missing: Jarvis cannot say its answer. It stays written in the conversation window.

data.name: VoiceModelMissing_Action
data.value: Download the voice on the Voice models page, then try it on the Voices page.

data.name: WakeWordModelMissing_Title
data.value: Wake word missing

data.name: WakeWordModelMissing_Explanation
data.value: The wake word files are missing: “Hey Jarvis” is not heard. The hotkey and a click on the orb still work.

data.name: WakeWordModelMissing_Action
data.value: Download the models on the Voice models page.

data.name: WhisperMissing_Title
data.value: Transcription model missing

data.name: WhisperMissing_Explanation
data.value: The Whisper model could not be loaded: Jarvis hears you but cannot transcribe your request.

data.name: WhisperMissing_Action
data.value: Download the Whisper model on the Voice models page, or pick a smaller one on the Transcription page. The problem goes away as soon as the model is loaded.

data.name: Voice_Title
data.value: Silent voice

data.name: Voice_Explanation
data.value: No voice could say the answer: the chosen voice is missing, the key of a cloud voice is missing or refused, or the audio output is gone. The answer stays written in the conversation window.

data.name: Voice_Action
data.value: Pick a voice on the Voices page and try it; also check the output on the Audio page. The problem goes away as soon as a voice is heard.

data.name: Unknown_Title
data.value: Problem

data.name: Unknown_Explanation
data.value: Jarvis ran into a problem.

data.name: Unknown_Action
data.value: Look at the log in %USERPROFILE%\.kazo\jarvis\logs.

data.name: Configuration_Title
data.value: Unreadable settings

data.name: Configuration_Unreadable
data.value: The config.json file could not be read. Jarvis runs on default values and saves no setting while this file is there. A copy is in the backups folder.

data.name: Configuration_NewerVersion
data.value: The config.json file was written by a newer version of Jarvis. Jarvis runs on default values and leaves this file alone.

data.name: Configuration_MigrationFailed
data.value: The config.json file could not be brought up to this version. Jarvis runs on default values and leaves this file alone. A copy is in the backups folder.

data.name: Configuration_Action_Unreadable
data.value: Fix or rename %USERPROFILE%\.kazo\jarvis\config.json, then restart Jarvis. Once renamed, a new file replaces it at the first setting saved.

data.name: Configuration_Action_NewerVersion
data.value: Install the newest version of Jarvis (“Updates…” menu), or rename %USERPROFILE%\.kazo\jarvis\config.json, then restart Jarvis.

data.name: Configuration_Action_MigrationFailed
data.value: Rename %USERPROFILE%\.kazo\jarvis\config.json, then restart Jarvis; the log says which step failed.
